name: repository-reentry
description: Reconstructs current truth across source, Git, GitHub, planning, and threadkeeping. Applies during resumed work, handoffs, status reconciliation, stale-plan review, and branch or pull-request re-entry.

contract.what: A compact model of settled, current, open, and next terrain.
when: Multi-cycle work resumes or repository records appear to disagree.
boundaries: Current behavior comes from runnable source and artifacts. Historical records preserve rationale. Repository edits require task authority. Re-entry recovers the current contract and differences without claiming personal memory, complete continuity, or familiarity that the available evidence cannot support.
contract.result: One source path, one live collaboration surface, and one bounded re-entry move.

receivingUse.job: Multi-cycle work resumes or repository records appear to disagree.
receivingUse.materialResult: One source path, one live collaboration surface, and one bounded re-entry move.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
